planEntities.description: Design and implement initiatives for women, girls, men, and boys at the community and individual level to mobilize actors, resources, and capacities to create an environment for zero tolerance of violence through engaging men, women, and young people in communities to foster favorable social attitudes and behaviors towards ending VAWG with participatory CTC (a community that cares) training with community representatives to update of the CTC action plans, workshops for religious leaders, teachers, and members of an interreligious local committee on services for survivors of VAW, conducting gender-transformative education and creating safe public plase, safe cities-safe urban planning initiative-pilot project.

planEntities.name: Design and implement capacity building activities to deliver quality, accessible and survivor-centered service
planEntities.parentName: Relevant authorities and CSOs have enhanced knowledge and assets to deliver a multi-sectoral response and prevention programmes to all forms of violence in line with international standards
planEntities.description: Capacity-building activities to deliver quality, accessible and survivor-centered service aimed at improving the knowledge and skills of the members of responsible institutions (municipal multisectoral teams, police officers) to provide standardized quality services in cases of domestic violence and sexual violence as well as the development of recommendations and training for judges and prosecutors in cases of sexual violence.

planEntities.name: Create an enabling legislative and policy environment in line with international standards on eliminating violence against women and other forms of discrimination
planEntities.parentName: Relevant authorities and CSOs have enhanced knowledge and assets to deliver a multi-sectoral response and prevention programmes to all forms of violence in line with international standards
planEntities.description: Create an enabling legislative and policy environment in line with international standards on eliminating violence against women and other forms of discrimination through advocacy for the sustainability of specialist services in legislation and policy, analysis of gaps in specialist services response to sexual violence cases.

planEntities.name: Promote favorable social norms and attitudes for advancing gender equality and prevent discrimination of and violence against women
planEntities.parentName: Relevant authorities and CSOs have enhanced knowledge and assets to deliver a multi-sectoral response and prevention programmes to all forms of violence in line with international standards
planEntities.description: Promote favorable social norms and attitudes for advancing gender equality and preventing discrimination and violence against women through engaging community members as agents of change, working with media on raising awareness of gender-based violence through campaigns, and increased awareness of the public on the need to enhance criminal legal protection of victims of sexual violence through social media.

planEntities.name: Empower women and girls (including those from disadvantaged groups) who have experienced discrimination or violence to advocate for and use available, accessible and quality services
planEntities.parentName: Relevant authorities and CSOs have enhanced knowledge and assets to deliver a multi-sectoral response and prevention programmes to all forms of violence in line with international standards
planEntities.description: Empower women and girls (including those from disadvantaged groups) who have experienced discrimination or violence to advocate for and use available, accessible and quality services through workshops with women, improving organizational capacities of shelters/safe spaces, support to data collection, analysis and dissemination of findings, capacity building of state and non-state service providers, advocating for CSOs to obtain resources and piloting an initiative to provide opportunities for economic reintegration for women exposed to violence among minority women.

planEntities.name: Design and implement capacity building activities to implement gender-responsive policy making, budgeting and integration of EU gender equality and women’s empowerment commitments across sectors.
planEntities.parentName: Authorities, including the judicial systems, have improved knowledge and access to relevant statistical data to develop and deliver more inclusive, evidence-based and gender-sensitive policy and regulatory frameworks
planEntities.description: Building knowledge and evidence of the Ministry of Finance, line ministries and gender institutional mechanisms to make informed budgetary allocation towards gender equality in line with national and international commitments; building capacities of local governments to apply GRB tools in their plans and budget; strengthening parliament and oversight bodies to monitor and advocate for gender-responsive policies and budgets; sensitizing media on the impact of budget on gender equality through capacity building activities; supporting institutional partners in the development of SDG Financing Ecosystem; strengthening capacities of gender institutional mechanisms on EU accession process; improving capacities of targeted institutions in BiH to include gender perspective aligned with EU gender acquis; enhancing the implementation and monitoring of the selected areas of the Gender Action Plan.

planEntities.name: Design and implement capacity buiding activities to ensure the necessary regulatory and procedural preconditions for increased political participation of women.
planEntities.parentName: Authorities, including the judicial systems, have improved knowledge and access to relevant statistical data to develop and deliver more inclusive, evidence-based and gender-sensitive policy and regulatory frameworks
planEntities.description: Strengthening capacities of government and political institutions to improve participation of women in public and political life; strengthening capacities of women in elected office, parliamentarians, and aspirants to engage in leadership contests effectively; building alliances around gender equality and promoting political participation of women

planEntities.name: Design and implement capacity building activities to effectively implement international and national normative standards on gender equality and women’s empowerment
planEntities.parentName: Authorities, including the judicial systems, have improved knowledge and access to relevant statistical data to develop and deliver more inclusive, evidence-based and gender-sensitive policy and regulatory frameworks
planEntities.description: Capacity building of the gender institutional mechanisms, line ministries and other relevant institutional actors for monitoring and implementing of international and national normative standards and coordination of development activities; localization of the Generation Equality Campaign and Action Coalitions for the gender equality and empowerment of women; continuous development of flagship products and strategic communications (Country Gender Equality Profile, Focus on Gender)

planEntities.name: Strengthen multi-stakeholder dialogues between government and CSOs stakeholders
planEntities.parentName: People and authorities in BiH make effective use of inclusive dialogue mechanisms for policy design and delivery
planEntities.description: Strengthen multi-stakeholder dialogues between government and CSOs stakeholders through capacity building of wide network of CSOs for monitoring of international and national normative standards, advocacy with the government and strategic engagement; Development of the framework monitoring system for the follow up on the implementation of key international and national normative standards and support to regular review and consultations between the government and CSOs.

Bosnia and Herzegovina.name: United Nations Development Programme
Bosnia and Herzegovina.organizationType: Multilateral - UN organizations excluding pooled funds

planEntities.name: Improve energy efficiency in public, residential and private sectors
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities have capacities and instruments to implement climate change adaptation and mitigation measures for resilient and sustainable development
planEntities.description: This sub-output focuses on support to authorities in Bosnia and Herzegovina, as well as communities and businesses to improve energy efficiency in public, residential and private sector through enhanced capacities, investment support, methodological assistance and expertise.

planEntities.name: Provide opportunities for girls and young women to develop their 21st century skills through formal, informal and non-formal education  (IT Girls - UNICEF Pillar)
planEntities.parentName: Adolescents, youth, and vulnerable groups, have improved their 21st century skills for active and productive participation in society
planEntities.description: This is to promote and support the participation of girls and women in STEM education and the IT labor market. Initiate is being implemented by UNICEF, UNDP, and UNWomen

planEntities.name: Improve technological environment in elementary/secondary schools for strengthening ICT skills (fab labs, IT labs, STEAM labs)
planEntities.parentName: Education institutions have enhanced capacities to provide quality inclusive education at all levels
planEntities.description: The UN will conduct a survey to help understand better the current digital education capacities at primary and secondary level in both entities. The UN will support the establishment of STEM laboratories in selected schools country-wide.

planEntities.name: Design and implement measures to empower civil society as a pro-active player in sustainable development
planEntities.parentName: Communities and local authorities have skills and tools to enhance social cohesion and peacebuilding in BiH
planEntities.description: The UN will further empower civil society organisation in the country, with a regional outreach to the wider Western Balkan region, with particular focus on voicing local communities and youth organisations.

planEntities.name: Develop a road safety strategic framework and pilot road safety smart solutions
planEntities.parentName: Authorities in BiH have enhanced capacities to ensure rule of law, access to justice, safety and security
planEntities.description: The UN will support practical implementation of priorities from the Framework Road Safety Strategy for Bosnia and Herzegovina and its Action Plan, with focus on piloting innovative data and technology solutions to contribute to improved road safety in selected urban areas.

planEntities.name: Design and implement measures to strengthen institutional capacities for mine action and sustainable management and disposal of remnants of war
planEntities.parentName: Authorities in BiH have enhanced capacities to ensure rule of law, access to justice, safety and security
planEntities.description: The UN will continue to support human security in the country through mine-action, disposal of surplus ammunition and weapons, as well as assist mine action authorities in Bosnia and Herzegovina to increase transparency, improve planning capabilities and implement contemporary mine action standards for an accelerated pace of mine clearance.

planEntities.name: Enhance technological capacity  and the effective interaction among the judiciary and law enforcement agencies
planEntities.parentName: Authorities in BiH have enhanced capacities to ensure rule of law, access to justice, safety and security
planEntities.description: The UN will support human rights – including as part of regional efforts, to empower civil society organisations stand for the rights of the vulnerable population groups, including victims of war crimes, as well as digitalising human rights monitoring and reporting mechanisms.

planEntities.name: Enhance efficiency and effectiveness of the criminal justice systems in investigating and prosecuting serious crimes, electronic monitoring of convicts, and adherence to basic Human Rights
planEntities.parentName: Authorities in BiH have enhanced capacities to ensure rule of law, access to justice, safety and security
planEntities.description: The UN will launch efforts to support authorities in Bosnia and Herzegovina improvement of the cybersecurity legislative and policy environment, as well as awareness, skills, and capabilities necessary to carry forward a coherent, secure, and resilient cybersecurity agenda in the country. The UN will design and deliver training programs for public servants across all government levels and embed them into the regular public civil servants’ training system.

planEntities.name: Design and implement measures to strengthen capacities of the public security system for border management and combatting illicit arms’ trafficking
planEntities.parentName: Authorities in BiH have enhanced capacities to ensure rule of law, access to justice, safety and security
planEntities.description: The UN will continue to enhance capacity of authorities for integrated border management to better fight illicit small arms and light and light weapons trafficking. Focus will be placed on enhancing cooperation and information exchange between Customs of Bosnia and Herzegovina and relevant institutions in the country, as well as with three neighboring countries.

planEntities.name: Develop inclusive and SDG-supportive policies and regulatory frameworks (across various sectors, including public finances)
planEntities.parentName: Authorities, including the judicial systems, have improved knowledge and access to relevant statistical data to develop and deliver more inclusive, evidence-based and gender-sensitive policy and regulatory frameworks
planEntities.description: The UN will support authorities conduct the preparation of a comprehensive Development Finance Assessment that provides an overview of the state of affairs when it comes to development financing in the country along with a roadmap for the SDG financing framework/strategy. Thus, the authorities will have a comprehensive assessment of existing financial flows supporting sustainable development and defining long term directions and innovative financial instruments for sustainable development financing.

planEntities.name: Strengthen institutional and technical capacity of authorities to manage, monitor and implement the SDG Framework for BiH
planEntities.parentName: Authorities, including the judicial systems, have improved knowledge and access to relevant statistical data to develop and deliver more inclusive, evidence-based and gender-sensitive policy and regulatory frameworks
planEntities.description: The UN will support authorities in the country, including the SDG Council, to operationalize the SDG Framework for Bosnia and Herzegovina and ensure its operationalization and implementation through development strategies and policies. The UN will support implementation and localisation of the SDG Framework for Bosnia and Herzegovina, enhancing coordination, monitoring, and reporting by the SDG Council, while also strengthening government capacities to align their development strategies and policies with the SDG commitments.

planEntities.name: Design and launch innovative, technology-based and scalable solutions that evidently and sustainably improve public consultation and citizen engagement in policy design and delivery, including for the socially excluded.
planEntities.parentName: Authorities, including the judicial systems, have improved knowledge and access to relevant statistical data to develop and deliver more inclusive, evidence-based and gender-sensitive policy and regulatory frameworks
planEntities.description: Authorities in the country will be supported to develop and deploy digital solutions which enable wider and more effective citizen engagement in public consultations, including for engaging civil society in EU IPA programming, piloting inclusive urban transformation via digital public consultations platform, etc.

planEntities.name: Introduce e-services, digital solutions, as well as digital skills in the public sector - with focus on women
planEntities.parentName: Authorities use more efficiently and effectively the financial, data and digital management tools to make the public services more people-centred and accessible
planEntities.description: The UN will further support digital transformation agenda in the public sector, intensifying its efforts on boosting of digital and innovation skills, promoting the importance of policy dialogue and long-term vision setting, as well as piloting e-services for more transparent and accessible public service.

planEntities.name: Advance financing for sustainable development, including by accountable public finance management
planEntities.parentName: Authorities use more efficiently and effectively the financial, data and digital management tools to make the public services more people-centred and accessible
planEntities.description: The UN will support authorities, in partnership with all relevant private and civic stakeholders, to develop the SDG Financing Framework for Bosnia and Herzegovina. The UN will support inclusive, accountable, and result-oriented performance of governments, focusing on quality public service delivery, as well as enhancing public finance management at the local and cantonal government levels.

planEntities.name: Develop and start implementation of key climate change frameworks
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities have capacities and instruments to implement climate change adaptation and mitigation measures for resilient and sustainable development
planEntities.description:
UN will support authorities to conduct strategic data analyses to serve as foundation for climate change strategic frameworks. Focus will also be placed on the setting in function of relevant public data systems in the area of GHG emissions and environment. Strategic frameworks include: Collection, Transportation and Disposal Strategy for Waste Container Management; Circular Economy Roadmap for Bosnia and Herzegovina; Sustainable Energy and Climate Action Plans for various local governments; Blueprint for Recognition and Application of the "Polluter Pays Principle"; Just Transition Strategy Towards Low-Carbon Economy for Carbon-Intensive Industries.
Support will also be provided to setting in function green financing models with a final goal to have sustainable green financing mechanism with continues income of resources. Another area of work includes unpacking and implementation of the Western Balkans Green Agenda in the country, following the signing of Sofia Declaration which obligates countries to further decarbonisation, introduction of circular economy etc.

planEntities.name: Integrate good local governance benchmarks, implement infrastructure investments and strengthen capacity and accountability of public enterprises - with focus on water supply and wastewater management services
planEntities.parentName: Authorities use more efficiently and effectively the financial, data and digital management tools to make the public services more people-centred and accessible
planEntities.description: The UN will continue to support inclusive, accountable, and result-oriented performance of governments, focusing on quality public service delivery, focusing on water supply and wastewater management, waste management, energy efficiency and improvement of public infrastructure. The UN, working in more than 80% of local governments country-wide, will leverage development partnerships to support policy reforms, including in the area of water services and local governance.

planEntities.name: Implement pilot efforts in the area of sustainable and inclusive urban development and future cities
planEntities.parentName: Authorities use more efficiently and effectively the financial, data and digital management tools to make the public services more people-centred and accessible
planEntities.description: The UN will support sustainable and inclusive urban transformation in several pilot localities in the country. This entails leveraging technology and citizen engagement for greener, accessible and healthier public environment.

planEntities.name: Advance policy and regulatory frameworks towards accelerated digital and green transition, improved competitiveness and recovery from the COVID-19 crisis
planEntities.parentName: Authorities have the knowledge and tools to make their economic measures and policies more competitive, sustainable, inclusive and resilient
planEntities.description: The UN will support relevant authorities to advance policy and regulatory frameworks towards accelerated digital and green transition. The UN will support the design of the Circular Economy Roadmap for Bosnia and Herzegovina, the new Agriculture and Rural Development Plan for Bosnia and Herzegovina, as well as the inclusive development of policies and regulations in the agri-food sector that ensure alignment with the European Union frameworks.

planEntities.name: Develop and implement climate change adaptation and mitigation solutions
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities have capacities and instruments to implement climate change adaptation and mitigation measures for resilient and sustainable development
planEntities.description:
Focus will be placed on providing technical and financial support to authorities at all levels and communities across the country to design and implement resilient climate change adaptation and mitigation measures. These include concrete efforts to address increasing vulnerability of communities and livelihoods to intensified climate-induced flood-related disasters. The UN will support authorities establish an integrated and innovative climate-resilient flood risk management, strengthen institutional, technical and financial capacity to implement long-term flood-resilient management strategies, including a combination of structural and non-structural measures and ecosystem-based approaches. 
The UN will also leverage technology and innovation to stimulate wider climate action, including through the TvojCO2 digital platform for carbon footprint offsetting.

planEntities.name: Develop and implement pilot solutions that contribute to improvement of air quality
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities have capacities and instruments to implement climate change adaptation and mitigation measures for resilient and sustainable development
planEntities.description: Efforts will be placed to support authorities, private sector and communities implement practical decarbonisation measures, with focus on decarbonisation in residential and SME sectors. Envisaged scope of work also includes support to cantonal financial and institutional mechanisms for long-term management of public decarbonisation measures.

planEntities.name: Design and deliver support measures for sustainable economic development, leveraging private sector investments (including by diaspora)
planEntities.parentName: Authorities have the knowledge and tools to make their economic measures and policies more competitive, sustainable, inclusive and resilient
planEntities.description: The UN will continue to support private sector development (primarily in agriculture, tourism, wood, metal processing sectors) and foster employment and skills development for jobs of the future, especially for young people. The UN will further support rural development to contribute to improvement of living conditions in rural areas in Bosnia and Herzegovina, including through the introduction of regenerative agriculture, sustainable tourism and circularity for the rural economic activities. The UN will support the digital transition of the private sector, especially in agri-food, thus enabling stronger participation of youth. Particular efforts will be placed on support to transition towards circular economy.

planEntities.name: Strengthen disaster risk capacity and implement adequate measures
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities have capacities and instruments to implement climate change adaptation and mitigation measures for resilient and sustainable development
planEntities.description:
The UN will continue to support people – with focus on the most vulnerable – and high-risk local communities in Bosnia and Herzegovina to prepare for and adapt to disaster risks and shocks across
various development sectors. Efforts will also be placed to introduce and operationalize an integrated model for disaster risk governance and livelihood enhancement at the local level, as a springboard to a bottom-up introduction of DRR governance in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

planEntities.name: Design and pilot nature-based solutions for depollution
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities are capacitated and equipped to manage and protect natural and cultural resources in a more sustainable and inclusive manner
planEntities.description: Design and pilot nature-based solutions for depollution, including in the areas of sustainable tourism, urban transformation and removal of persistent organic pollutants in soil.

planEntities.name: Pilot and scale up successful approaches in waste management and identify priority policy/regulatory frameworks that need to be in place to enable reduced waste and reuse/recycling systems in industries and communities
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities are capacitated and equipped to manage and protect natural and cultural resources in a more sustainable and inclusive manner
planEntities.description: The UN will support authorities strengthen waste management capacity and systems, with focus on industrial and hazardous waste. Data and analytical capabilities of institutions and communal enterprises will be enhanced via a new waste management public data (digital) system, as well as modelling for waste management route-optimization for selected local governments in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Authorities and all relevant stakeholders will be supported to develop the Collection, Transportation and Disposal Strategy for Waste Container Management.

planEntities.name: Develop environmental management plans for persistent organic pollutants-contaminated sites
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities are capacitated and equipped to manage and protect natural and cultural resources in a more sustainable and inclusive manner
planEntities.description:
The UN will continue to offer technical and policy advice to authorities and communities, particularly the most affected and contaminated areas in the country. The UN will 
help authorities prevent the release in persistent organic pollutants in the environment through improvement of health care waste management, implementation of green chemistry initiatives in the industry and agriculture, along with destruction of identified persistent organic pollutants waste stockpiles.

planEntities.name: Support private sector to strengthen competitiveness and introduce green and circular business models
planEntities.parentName: The private sector has the capacities to apply sustainable growth principles for inclusive economic development and decent jobs
planEntities.description: The UN will support the private sector to transition towards circular and green business models, guided by the Circular Economy Roadmap for Bosnia and Herzegovina. The UN will also continue to raise awareness, engage and collaborate with the private sector, nurturing SDG champions who pioneer green economy solutions in the country.  The UN will seek to support  removal of barriers for emerging entrepreneurs through immediate and quality business support services, while future entrepreneurs will be nurtured with skills, knowledge and abilities acquired through formal and informal education. Particular focus will also be placed on boosting research and development capabilities in the private sector.

planEntities.name: Design and implement measures to empower local communities / mjesne zajednice as vibrant and democratic cells of society
planEntities.parentName: Communities and local authorities have skills and tools to enhance social cohesion and peacebuilding in BiH
planEntities.description: Privileging UN's advocacy role and work towards social cohesion and the strengthening of the social contract, the UN will further engage with citizens – especially young people and governments with focus on trust building, scaling up regional peace-building initiatives and empowering communities.

planEntities.name: Integrate practices for inclusive community dialogue and introduce transparent financing mechanisms for civil society engagement in local development
planEntities.parentName: Communities and local authorities have skills and tools to enhance social cohesion and peacebuilding in BiH
planEntities.description: The UN collaborates with local governments and civil society organization in the Western Balkans to engage in productive partnerships and contribute to improving service delivery and realization of local priorities in line with development strategies. The UN supports local authorities to use public funding of CSOs in a transparent and development-oriented manner, recognizing local needs and adopting a project-based approach.

planEntities.name: Design and implement measures to strengthen community activism, especially among youth and women
planEntities.parentName: Communities and local authorities have skills and tools to enhance social cohesion and peacebuilding in BiH
planEntities.description: The UN will further engage with citizens – especially young people, women and governments with focus on trust building, scaling up regional peace-building initiatives and further empowering civil society and communities as agents of change at the local level. Work at the community level platforms for dialogue will continue to serve as mechanisms to facilitate social dialogue and voice the socially excluded community members.

planEntities.name: Enhance skill development, entrepreneurship and job creation in the private sector with focus on young people, women and persons with disabilities
planEntities.parentName: The private sector has the capacities to apply sustainable growth principles for inclusive economic development and decent jobs
planEntities.description: The UN will focus on developing skills for future jobs in selected economic sectors pertaining to sustainable economic development, circular economy and digital economy. Further efforts will be placed on strengthening entrepreneurship skills for young people, as well as digital skills for women to help them advance their career in tech-driven industries.

planEntities.name: Raise awareness of the private sector to contribute to SDGs implementation
planEntities.parentName: The private sector has the capacities to apply sustainable growth principles for inclusive economic development and decent jobs
planEntities.description: The UN will continue to raise awareness and capacity of the private sector to contribute to implementation of the SDGs, as well as motivate and promote SDG champions in the private sector who are embracing circular and green business models and thus contributing to sustainable growth of the country. The SDG Annual Business Awards will be supported for a fourth consecutive year.

planEntities.name: Design and implement socially responsive policy measures to strengthen the social protection system based on evidence on the emerging vulnerabilities of people, households and institutions from COVID-19 pandemics
planEntities.parentName: Relevant authorities and institutions have the relevant statistical data, knowledge, and tools to deliver more inclusive, efficient and shock-responsive social protection
planEntities.description: Design and implement socially responsive policy measures to strengthen the social protection system based on evidence on the emerging vulnerabilities of people, households and institutions from COVID-19 pandemics

planEntities.name: Design and implement measures to leverage technology for improved data management and accessibility of health services.
planEntities.parentName: Health systems have knowledge and means to provide more inclusive, resilient and preventive health services, including in response to the COVID-19 pandemic
planEntities.description: Design and implement measures to leverage technology for improved data management and accessibility of health services.

planEntities.name: Procure vital medical supplies and equipment, including for COVID-19, in partnership with relevant authorities in BiH
planEntities.parentName: Health systems have knowledge and means to provide more inclusive, resilient and preventive health services, including in response to the COVID-19 pandemic
planEntities.description: The UN will support authorities in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina to strengthen their capabilities and procure medical items and equipment necessary to tackle COVID-19 pandemic.

planEntities.name: Enhance management of protected areas
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities are capacitated and equipped to manage and protect natural and cultural resources in a more sustainable and inclusive manner
planEntities.description: Enhance management of protected areas

Bosnia and Herzegovina.name: United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction
Bosnia and Herzegovina.organizationType: Multilateral - UN organizations excluding pooled funds

planEntities.name: Design and implement measures to strengthen urban resilience to disasters
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities have capacities and instruments to implement climate change adaptation and mitigation measures for resilient and sustainable development
planEntities.description: Provide support to disaster resilience self-assessment efforts by the local entities, at both city and cantonal level, and participation of cities and cantons in the global Making Cities Resilient 2030 Initiative.  Initiative aims to support 5 entities from Bosnia and Herzegovina joining the global network, and completion of a baseline resilience assessment with Central-Bosnia Canton.

Bosnia and Herzegovina.name: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe
Bosnia and Herzegovina.organizationType: Multilateral - UN organizations excluding pooled funds

planEntities.name: Support the development of the national statistical system through a Global Assessment and/or Sector Reviews on request from the Agency for Statistics
planEntities.parentName: Relevant authorities and institutions have the relevant statistical data, knowledge, and tools to deliver more inclusive, efficient and shock-responsive social protection
planEntities.description: On request from the Agency for Statistics, conduct reviews and provide other support as required

planEntities.name: Strenghtening national capacities for implementation of the Framework Road Safety Strategy for BiH and accession to UN road safety related legal instruments
planEntities.parentName: Authorities in BiH have enhanced capacities to ensure rule of law, access to justice, safety and security
planEntities.description: Workshops with the aim to strengthen the knowledge of BiH Government officials and national experts on the most pressing road safety issues identified in FRSS.

planEntities.name: Regional study on Energy Efficiency Standards
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities have capacities and instruments to implement climate change adaptation and mitigation measures for resilient and sustainable development
planEntities.description:
Regional study on gap analysis between the performance objectives set forth in the Framework Guidelines for Energy Efficiency Standards in Buildings and current energy efficiency standards and their implementation in the countries of South-Eastern and Eastern Europe, the Caucasus, Central Asia, and in the Russian Federation; three regional workshops; Collaborative Environment for experts in energy efficiency in buildings. 
To enhance capacity of the UNECE member States to develop and implement energy efficiency standards for buildings, with a focus on residential buildings, introduce energy efficiency technologies, overcoming barriers to tightening energy efficiency standards and accelerating uptake of energy efficient technologies through improved knowledge of best practices in this field.  Bosnia and Herzegovina is one of the beneficiary countries.

planEntities.name: Renewable Energy Status Report
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities have capacities and instruments to implement climate change adaptation and mitigation measures for resilient and sustainable development
planEntities.description: The Report examines the status of renewable energy in 17 UNECE focus countries plus Kosovo, focusing on South-East and Eastern Europe, the Caucasus, Central Asia and the Russian Federation. It aims to promote the development of renewable energy in the region, examining the evidence and raising awareness about the vast potential of renewables and their benefits in the focus countries. It provides the most recent statistics and trends, and their assessment and interpretation, at both the country and the regional level.

planEntities.name: Decarbonize transport sector by increasing use of natural gas as a motor fuel
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities have capacities and instruments to implement climate change adaptation and mitigation measures for resilient and sustainable development
planEntities.description: Bosnia and Herzegovina is among the beneficiaries of the project: XB project “Improving capacities of UNECE member States to decarbonize the transport sector by increasing the use of natural gas as a motor fuel” (donor - Russian Federation). The project develops and disseminates recommendations and policy guidelines that, when fully implemented, would effectively increase the share of natural gas in road transportation and hence reduce the carbon footprint of this critical sector.

planEntities.name: Carbon Neutrality by 2050 toolkit
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities have capacities and instruments to implement climate change adaptation and mitigation measures for resilient and sustainable development
planEntities.description: The aim of the project funded by the United States Energy Association and World Nuclear Association is to identify policy and technology options to attain carbon neutrality by 2050. The project developed a number of technology briefs and publications that form the UNECE Carbon Neutrality Toolkit tailored for policy makers to make informed decisions.

Bosnia and Herzegovina.name: United Nations Environment Programme
Bosnia and Herzegovina.organizationType: Multilateral - UN organizations excluding pooled funds

planEntities.name: Enhance nature protection and protected areas network in the country
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities have capacities and instruments to implement climate change adaptation and mitigation measures for resilient and sustainable development
planEntities.description:
Enhance nature protection and protected areas network in the country. 
Rapid screening of alignment with the GBF and update of existing NBSAPs, to integrate/ update national goals, targets, and indicators as needed to implement the GBF

planEntities.name: Establish sustainable land monitoring and information sharing system
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities have capacities and instruments to implement climate change adaptation and mitigation measures for resilient and sustainable development
planEntities.description:
Establish sustainable land monitoring and information sharing system.
Creating an enabling environment to support LDN target implementation through strengthening national and local capacity and establishing an LDN monitoring and reporting system in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

Bosnia and Herzegovina.name: United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organisation
Bosnia and Herzegovina.organizationType: Multilateral - UN organizations excluding pooled funds

planEntities.name: Conduct school safety assessments using (VISUS) methodology in minimum 40 schools
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities have capacities and instruments to implement climate change adaptation and mitigation measures for resilient and sustainable development
planEntities.description: School safety is one of the main concerns of administrators and decision-makers both for saving lives and for guaranteeing the continuity of education. Within the Joint UN DRR project, UNESCO is conducting a schools safety risk assessments in 10 high-risk local communities in BiH, in order to provide decision-makers with relevant scientifically based information concerning a quick assessment of safety situations, upgrading needs and status conditions of existing learning facilities. To ensure sustainability, the safety assessment methodology will be shared with local governments and their responsible department, so to encourage its systemic future use in terms of schools’ safety approach, as well as planning of adequate measures and investments from public budgets.

planEntities.name: Support authorities to measure and monitor the progress of culture’s enabling contribution to the national and local implementation of the Agenda2030
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities are capacitated and equipped to manage and protect natural and cultural resources in a more sustainable and inclusive manner
planEntities.description: Indicators are intended to measure and monitor the progress of culture’s contribution to the national and local implementation of the Goals and Targets of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. It will capacitate government to work diligently on establishment of systems for monitoring and reporting related to the 2030 Agenda. In addition to 12 goals and 21 target, the Framework also contributes transversally to SDG 5 on gender equality, notably its Target 5.5 on women’s participation and leadership. To achieve this, the Framework  allows the appreciation of gender equality across a number of data points from access to opportunities and their participation in social, economic, political and cultural life.

planEntities.name: Design and implement capacity building measures for enhancing protection of cultural heritage and fighting illicit trafficking of cultural property
planEntities.parentName: Authorities and communities are capacitated and equipped to manage and protect natural and cultural resources in a more sustainable and inclusive manner

planEntities.name: 2.4.4 Reducing the advance of Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) in food and agriculture
planEntities.parentName: Emergency preparedness is increased for major hazards, including transboundary animal and plant pests and diseases, and food safety hazards, considering specific regional factors, needs of vulnerable groups, needs of men and women, and based on the commitments to environmental conventions
planEntities.description: In 2023, as part of the project “Reducing the advance of antimicrobial resistance in food and agriculture,” which aims to combat the proliferation of drug-resistant microorganisms, FAO conducted a training of the staff of the National Veterinary Laboratories on the FAO Assessment Tool for Laboratories and Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance Systems (ATLASS). The veterinary curriculum on AMR learning outcomes of two universities was assessed using a dedicated assessment tool for veterinary faculties. In addition, Central and Regional Veterinary Administration and laboratories were trained on how to analyze critical points of livestock farm production flow where antimicrobials are mostly used and on how to minimize the use of antimicrobial in livestock. Further sub-national trainings, including on-farm training were held in different districts targeting veterinarians, zootechnicians and farm managers in different districts. FAO continued to actively contribute to the World AMR Awareness Week. In 2023, presentations on antimicrobial use and AMR were delivered in veterinary events and meetings, to teaching staff of veterinary academia and addressed in articles published in scientific newspapers and websites. The project supports the development and implementation of surveillance systems and national action plans to combat antimicrobial resistance in Belarus. (GCP/RER/057/RUS)

planEntities.name: 2.4.5 Strengthening the resilience of pine forest to bark beetle outbreaks and associated dieback

planEntities.description:
National surveillance and monitoring systems were revised and a set of recommendations for further follow-up at country level formulated with the aim of leading to the development of functional early warning systems.
The target country was assisted in developing national contingency plans for forest pest outbreaks for selected species, which were validated with regional and district forest managers.
Guidelines were developed for improving the resilience of forest stands in relation to forest health and enhancing drought mitigation.
National capacities on communication and regional coordination in relation to forest health issues were strengthened.
National capacities were strengthened to increase the resilience of forest ecosystems to unfavourable biotic and abiotic factors.  
(Closed project - TCP/RER/3801)

planEntities.description: The aim of the project is to contribute to the improvement and consolidation of the Brazilian National Policy on Food Security and Nutrition, by strengthening the Brazilian National System for Food and Nutrition Security (SISAN) in Brazil, with emphasis on the concretization of a supply policy and in actions turned to the overcoming of the extreme poverty.

planEntities.name: FAO UTF/BRA/083/BRA - New production and social organization of Brazilian family farming - a need
planEntities.parentName: 1.1 Public policies and institutional capacities strengthened in the areas of education, health, social assistance, food security and nutrition and decent work in order to address the needs of the most vulnerable groups and promote gender, race, ethnicity throughout the life course
planEntities.description: The project aims to strengthen family farming's strategic role amidst national and rural development, by working with its four basic roles: food security, environment, economic feasibility and social role; to incorporate new management practices for production development in family farming that meet the needs of sectors with little production capacity.

planEntities.name: FAO UTF/BRA/084/BRA - Toward Sustainable Development in Aquaculture
planEntities.parentName: 4.1 Public policies, private initiatives and institutional capacities strengthened to promote the improvement of value chains, stimulating innovation, entrepreneurship and associativism, improving competitiveness to promote productive inclusion and sustainable economic development
planEntities.description: The project aims at contributing to the aquaculture's sustainable development by promoting the strengthening of the aquaculture productive chain, with its diversity and ordainment to increase production and promote social inclusion, thus increasing income and job offer to low-income populations and other relevant actors in the sector.

planEntities.name: FAO UTF/BRA/087/BRA - Promotion of Public Policies for Regional Development
planEntities.parentName: 4.1 Public policies, private initiatives and institutional capacities strengthened to promote the improvement of value chains, stimulating innovation, entrepreneurship and associativism, improving competitiveness to promote productive inclusion and sustainable economic development
planEntities.description: The project will contribute to the promotion of regional development and Brazilian spatial planning by supporting and planning the sustainable occupation of space, promoting water sustainability and productive inclusion.

planEntities.name: FAO UTF/BRA/089/BRA - Consolidation of the Productive and Socioeconomic Organization of Family Farming in Brazil
planEntities.parentName: 1.1 Public policies and institutional capacities strengthened in the areas of education, health, social assistance, food security and nutrition and decent work in order to address the needs of the most vulnerable groups and promote gender, race, ethnicity throughout the life course
planEntities.description: The project objective is to contribute to the national processes of strengthening family farmers in Brazil for poverty reduction and rural revitalization.The outcome is: the Brazilian Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock, together with the Secretary of Family Agriculture and Cooperativism, implements differentiated policies and programs that improve the capacities of the national government, local and family farmers in areas such as ATER (rural extension and technical advisory services), Credit Programs, land access and governance, access to markets and the strengthening of cooperativism

planEntities.name: FAO GCP/BRA/085/GFF - Reversing Desertification Process in Susceptible Areas of Brazil: Sustainable Agroforestry Practices and Biodiversity Conservation (REDESER) (FSP)
planEntities.parentName: 2.1 Strengthened participatory regional and subnational governance models for natural resource management, ecosystem services and climate change adaptation and mitigation in urban and rural areas
planEntities.description: The project will support the mitigation effects of degradation on natural resources, especially forests, biodiversity and water resources, thus contributing to poverty reduction and improved quality of life in areas susceptible to desertification process (ASD) in Brazil.

planEntities.name: FAO GCP /BRA/091/GFF - Strengthening participatory natural resource management processes for sustainable economic development, conservation of biodiversity and maintenance of carbon stocks in Amazon Wetlands. (PPG)
planEntities.parentName: 3.1 Institutional capacities of governmental, non-governmental organizations and multi-sector networks strengthened to support innovation and the transition to more sustainable management of natural resources and ecosystem services, as well as to combat climate change and its adverse effects in rural and urban areas
planEntities.description: The Project “Strengthening participatory natural resource management processes for sustainable economic development, conservation of biodiversity and maintenance of carbon stocks in Amazon Wetlands” seeks to promote and improve initiatives of participatory management of biodiversity as a form of sustainable economic and social development, strengthening value chains based on biodiversity, improving local livelihoods, conserving biodiversity, maintaining carbon stocks, and avoiding the emission of greenhouse gases. This will be done through the preparation and implementation of a capacity building program and community-based management plans to ensure local people can implement management protocols for agroforestry, timber and non-timber products, pirarucu, caiman, mangrove crab, and community-based tourism.

planEntities.name: FAO GCP/BRA/092P/GFF - Sustaining Healthy Coastal and Marine Ecosystems (PPG)
planEntities.parentName: 3.1 Institutional capacities of governmental, non-governmental organizations and multi-sector networks strengthened to support innovation and the transition to more sustainable management of natural resources and ecosystem services, as well as to combat climate change and its adverse effects in rural and urban areas
planEntities.description:
In line with the Brazilian Blue Initiative, the proposed project seeks to reinforce and expand current efforts to protect and manage Brazil’s extensive coastal and marine environments and the rich biodiversity and ecosystem services they support, fostering an enabling environment for a sustainable and equitable Blue Economy based on this natural capital. More specifically, the project aims at improving the management and financial sustainability of the Marine and Coastal Protected Area (MCPA) system by: (i) strengthening the capacities of key institutions such as the Interministerial Commission for Marine Resources (CIRM); (ii) by strengthening and ensuring long term sustainability of the financing strategy of the MCPA system; and (iii) by enhancing biodiversity monitoring and assessing gaps and needs for effective connectivity across the MCPA system. The project will support the implementation of MCPA management plans in selected target sites and implement actions to address threats to biodiversity in these sites. 

In parallel, the project will support actions to help mainstream Blue Economy principles; and support innovative approaches and technologies for the conservation and sustainable use of marine and coastal resources. Additionally, the project will support local, national and international knowledge exchange and collaboration, helping to build the capacity of Brazilian stakeholders to effectively contribute to the management and sustainable use of coastal and marine environments as the foundation for a Blue Economy.

planEntities.name: FAO GCP/BRA/093/GCR - Brazilian Agriculture and Livestock Platform of Sustainability: Traceability and Certification
planEntities.parentName: 4.1 Public policies, private initiatives and institutional capacities strengthened to promote the improvement of value chains, stimulating innovation, entrepreneurship and associativism, improving competitiveness to promote productive inclusion and sustainable economic development
planEntities.description: The objective of the project is to develop the Brazilian Agriculture and Livestock Platform of Sustainability: Traceability and Certification for Supply Chains, to promote a low-emission and reduced deforestation development, systematizing information from different sources. On its stage 1, corresponding to the present project under the Readiness instrument of the GCF, the project will tackle cattle and soybean in the Legal Amazon.

planEntities.name: FAO GCP/RLA/230/GFF - Binational and integrated water resources management in the Merín Lagoon Basin and Coastal Lagoons
planEntities.parentName: 3.1 Institutional capacities of governmental, non-governmental organizations and multi-sector networks strengthened to support innovation and the transition to more sustainable management of natural resources and ecosystem services, as well as to combat climate change and its adverse effects in rural and urban areas
planEntities.description: The objective of the project is to strengthen the capacities of the public and private sectors in Brazil and Uruguay for the joint and integrated management of water resources in the basin of the Merín Lagoon, the Yaguaron River and the coastal lagoons, with emphasis on the sustainable and efficient use of water, the preservation of ecosystems and their services, and adaptation to climate change, through the development of a Strategic Action Program.

planEntities.name: FAO UTF/BRA/088/BRA - Territorial intelligence of agroenvironmental governance in Brazil: Trans-sectorial integration between management and territory aiming at large-scale results from agro-environmental public policies
planEntities.parentName: 3.1 Institutional capacities of governmental, non-governmental organizations and multi-sector networks strengthened to support innovation and the transition to more sustainable management of natural resources and ecosystem services, as well as to combat climate change and its adverse effects in rural and urban areas
planEntities.description: The project to aims to structure a matching system between agro-environmental public policy and territory at different scales of action (municipal, state and federal), including data survey, selection and organization of information and development of components and complementary models identified as critical to environmental issues and that are still unavailable for application. The expected impact of the joint initiative is that the MMA's capacity to execute actions will be amplified in an efficient and qualitative way, through advanced management tools developed with FAO's expertise, in an integrated and synergic way.

planEntities.name: Support to the land regulation process in the state of Piauí

planEntities.description: Contribute to strengthening the institutional capacity of the government of Piauí for the implementation of public policies for land tenure regularization and land title, emphasizing policies, programs and actions that contribute to the promotion of productive inclusion, the maintenance of food and nutrition security, and the reduction of gender inequalities in these territories.

planEntities.name: Atlantic Forest conservation through sustainable management of cocoa agroforestry landscapes
planEntities.parentName: 3.2 The country is supported to strengthen its institutional capacities in order to promote sustainable production and consumption, as well as the management of natural resources in rural and urban areas
planEntities.description: The main problem to be addressed is the trend of loss of the tiny rainforest cover, which is very rich in biodiversity and biomass, in private land in southern Bahia state, where there are relevant remnants of Mata Atlantica, and to avoid a land use change (LUCF) toward pasture and grain production.

planEntities.description: The Viva o Semiárido Project (PVSA) aims to reduce poverty, increase production and improve the standard of living of populations with higher of social and economic deprivation in the rural environment of the semi-arid region of Piauí, through the increase of predominant productive activities, income generation and organizational strengthening of rural families. The project operates in 89 municipalities in five territories in Piauí: Vale do Sambito (15 municipalities), Vale do Rio Guaribas (39), Vale do Rio Canindé (17), Serra da Capivara (18) and Chapada Vale do Rio Itaim (16). ). The investments are intended for business plans aimed at the activities of beekeeping, sheep and goat farming, cashew farming, fish farming, poultry farming, productive backyards, pig farming, cassava farming, irrigation and handicrafts.

planEntities.description: The Dom Helder Camara Project (PDHC): Policy Coordination and Dialogue for Reducing Poverty and Inequalities in Semi-Arid North-east Brazil aims to reduce rural poverty and inequalities in the Brazilian semiarid region.  The Project seeks to reduce the levels of poverty and inequality in the semiarid region, promote the articulation of federal, state and municipal public policies, in addition to qualifying producers for the development of sustainable production, encouraging the replication of good practices. The area covered by the PDHC are municipalities from the Semiarid Region of the nine states from the Northeast Region, plus municipalities from the north of the states of Minas Gerais and Espírito Santo.

planEntities.parentName: 1.1 Public policies and institutional capacities strengthened in the areas of education, health, social assistance, food security and nutrition and decent work in order to address the needs of the most vulnerable groups and promote gender, race, ethnicity throughout the life course
planEntities.description: The Pro-Semiarid: Rural Sustainable Development Project in the Semi-arid Region of Bahia aims to promote rural development based on agroecological principles, with productive inclusion, and generation of employment and income. The construction of water supply systems, agro-industries, technical assistance and rural extension (ATER), technical training for producers and work in socio-productive cooperation networks are among the actions implemented by this project. The project's actions are coordinated regionally by the Territorial Support Services for Family Agriculture (SETAFs): Juazeiro, Senhor do Bonfim and Jacobina. In addition, the project has ten local ATER entities, 25 agronomists, veterinarians and social workers, 115 agricultural technicians and 115 young people, between 19 and 25 years old, who act as Rural Community Agents (ACR), acting directly in 460 communities in 32 selected municipalities, in five Identity Territories. The municipalities covered by the Project are: Capim Grosso, Quixabeira, Várzea do Poço, Caem, Jacobina, Mirangaba, Ourolândia, Saúde, Serrolândia, Umburanas, Várzea Nova, Miguel Calmon, Andorinha, Antônio Gonçalves, Caldeirão Grande, Campo Formoso, Philadelphia, Jaguarari, Pindobaçu, Ponto Novo, Senhor do Bonfim, Itiúba, Queimadas, Casa Nova, Curaçá, Juazeiro, Remanso, Sento Sé, Sobradinho, Uauá, Campo Alegre de Lourdes and Pilão Arcado.

planEntities.name: IFAD - 2000002987 - Amazon Sustainable Management Project (PAGES)
planEntities.parentName: 1.1 Public policies and institutional capacities strengthened in the areas of education, health, social assistance, food security and nutrition and decent work in order to address the needs of the most vulnerable groups and promote gender, race, ethnicity throughout the life course
planEntities.description: PAGES’ goal is to contribute to reducing rural poverty while decreasing deforestation and environmental degradation in the Amazon region of Maranhão. Its development objective is to improve the livelihoods and the food and nutrition security of the rural poor through the conservation and sustainable use of the Amazon rainforest. Through the intervention, the project will increase the resilience of 64,000 people and reduce approximately 6 million tons of CO2 equivalent. The intervention area comprises three development regions in the state: Maranhense Amazon, Maranhense Gurupi, and Pindaré. The target group includes 20,000 organized family farms facing poverty and associated with rural organizations (approximately 80,000 people), at least 12,5% of which are from 2,500 indigenous and other traditional communities (about 1,200 indigenous families, 800 quilombolas, and 500 coconut breakers), 50% women and 25     % young people.

planEntities.description:
This project addresses three key issues:
- Ensuring that a successful approach to employment training for groups vulnerable to discrimination on grounds sensitive to gender and covered by international labour and human rights standards is adapted and more widely available both in terms of potential trainees and in occupations covered.
- Building the capacity of government, employers’, workers’ and civil society organizations to realize objectives of national strategies on decent work for these groups; and
- Disseminating models, methodologies, strategies and the lessons learned and for replication in states in Brazil.
The project builds on the success and achievements of a programme of employment training and workforce engagement for persons in vulnerability, adapting the learning to address the unique needs of specific groups seeking decent employment and self-employment.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN Human Rights of Indigenous and Quilombola Women: A Governance Matter
planEntities.parentName: 1.1 Public policies and institutional capacities strengthened in the areas of education, health, social assistance, food security and nutrition and decent work in order to address the needs of the most vulnerable groups and promote gender, race, ethnicity throughout the life course
planEntities.description: The project is implemented in the border states of Maranhão and Pará with an expressive presence of both Indigenous and Quilombola communities living in forest areas (North and Northeast regions). UN Women draws on its strong partnerships with Indigenous women’s networks sustained since 2014 through the “Voices of Indigenous Women” group and with Quilombola’s CONAQ to facilitate integration of their rights in governance processes, which directly affects them and their communities’ lives. Prioritizing the Indigenous and Quilombola women, the most marginalized and vulnerable population groups, UN Women implements the SDG Leaving No One Behind principle, which is particularly relevant in the selected two states. The project facilitates inclusion and meaningful participation of these women in policy-making, state and municipal planning and budgeting, thus ensuring that the governance processes in Maranhão and Pará go beyond averages, aim to reach everyone and thus, prevent and eliminate discrimination and inequalities based on gender, race and ethnicity. Taking into account that Indigenous and Quilombola women face higher risks and greater burdens from the impacts of deforestation and climate change, the project also aims to address the compound inequalities and discrimination that often prevent women from fully contributing to climate-related planning, policy-making and implementation.

planEntities.description: UN Women and the Itabira municipal administration launched the project “Cidade 50-50: Itabira” (50-50 City) on August 15, 2019. The project is part of an UN Women initiative to pinpoint the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in Brazilian municipalities, and to support Itabira’s government in promoting the human rights of girls and women in line with the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. To this end, the project promotes the improvement of the government's capacity to formulate, implement and monitor policies that advance women's political participation, boost their economic empowerment, that integrate equally the needs of men and women, and prevent and address violence against girls and women. The funding resources for the project implementation were generously provided by the Itabira City Hall.

planEntities.parentName: 5.1 Public policies and private initiatives reinforced and encouraged for full employment and decent work, with an emphasis on the promotion of fundamental principles and rights at work, with special attention to the most vulnerable groups and to the promotion of gender, race, ethnicity and age equality and democracy in the workplace
planEntities.description: The joint program is funded by the Government of Luxembourg and its implementing agencies are UN Women, the United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) and the UN Refugee Agency (UNHCR). Started in August 2021, the program will be implemented over 2022 and 2023. The overall objective of the program is to ensure that policies and strategies of companies and public and private institutions strengthen economic rights and development opportunities for Venezuelan refugee and migrant women. To achieve this objective, the initiative is built on three axis. The first targets companies, institutions and governments on issues and actions related to decent work, social protection and entrepreneurship. The second directly addresses refugee and migrant women, so that they have access to training and opportunities to participate in decision-making processes related to the labor market and entrepreneurship. And the third also targets refugee and migrant women, so that they have knowledge and access to services that respond to gender-based violence.

planEntities.description: The Partnership Programme with the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women (UN Women) for South-South Cooperation aims to consolidate institutional capacities for the promotion of women's rights in Brazil and partner countries, as well as to support the Brazilian Cooperation Agency to incorporate gender mainstreaming in its Programmes and projects. In Brazil, UN Women has played a key role in qualifying the debate on gender equality and in promoting women's rights. This contribution has been made by public advocacy of global and regional norms that respect gender equality; technical assistance to national and subnational government institutions to comply with these standards; by capitalizing and disseminating knowledge, tools and methodologies for the promotion of women's rights; and by creating spaces for dialogue between governments, civil society and the private sector to raise the profile of the issue and promote an active and concrete intersectoral agenda for women's empowerment. This agreement benefits from the positive discourse and relies on the international commitments made publicly and internationally by Brazil and takes advantage of the accumulated Brazilian experiences in the area of promoting gender equality. It is aimed at fostering the centrality of gender equality in Brazilian cooperation and implement South-South cooperation projects that support the advancement of women's rights in Brazil and in partner countries.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN One Win Leads to Another
planEntities.parentName: 6.1 Legislation, public policies and institutional capacities strengthened and aligned with international human rights standards to protect, prevent and respond to violence, crime, exploitation, neglect and discrimination, including against groups in situations of greater vulnerability or emergency, considering gender, race, ethnicity, origin, nationality and age, ensuring democratic and transparent governance with broad social participation and access to justice
planEntities.description: The  Programme  One  Win  Leads  to  Another  (OWLA)  is  a  programme  implemented  by  UN  Women in partnership with the International Olympic Committee that seeks to use sports as a powerful social transformation tool to reduce harmful gender stereotypes, norms and related behaviours that prevent women and girls to fully enjoy their rights on an equal playing field. The OWLA programme aims at empowering girls through sports so that they can participate, work, govern and enjoy their rights on an equal playing field. Its overall objective is to use sport to change harmful gender stereotypes and norms, so that teenage girls can achieve their rights and fully develop their potential.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN Connecting Women, Defending Rights
planEntities.parentName: 6.1 Legislation, public policies and institutional capacities strengthened and aligned with international human rights standards to protect, prevent and respond to violence, crime, exploitation, neglect and discrimination, including against groups in situations of greater vulnerability or emergency, considering gender, race, ethnicity, origin, nationality and age, ensuring democratic and transparent governance with broad social participation and access to justice
planEntities.description: Funded by the European Union (EU) and implemented by United Nations Entity for the Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women (UN Women), Connecting Women, Defending Rights (CWDR) is a 40-months long project aimed at supporting Women Human Rights Defenders (WHRDs) in Brazil in their efforts to advance and sustain prevention and response to human rights violations and violence against women and girls. CWDR enables conditions for WHRDs to strengthen solidarity, skills, and communication among WHRDs for early warning and self-protection against threats and violence. Specifically, the action (1) provides WHRDs with safe spaces to develop collective action, advocacy, and protection strategies and (2) influences public outreach to address harmful stereotypes and hate-speech.

planEntities.name: UN WOMEN Raising political participation of women in Brazil
planEntities.parentName: 1.1 Public policies and institutional capacities strengthened in the areas of education, health, social assistance, food security and nutrition and decent work in order to address the needs of the most vulnerable groups and promote gender, race, ethnicity throughout the life course
planEntities.description: The project contributes to enhancing the participation of women, particularly those facing compounded discrimination, in public life in Brazil by supporting the advocacy to improve legal arrangements and tackle the obstacles preventing their access to decision-making positions. This advancement of parity democracy is sought by increasing the technical capacity of women, particularly Afro-Brazilian and Indigenous, to carry out advocacy initiatives and to engage in leadership roles; by supporting a campaign to raise awareness on political violence against women in politics; and by generating evidence on the obstacles for women’s political participation.

planEntities.name: SDG ECD  Joint Programme
planEntities.parentName: 1.1 Public policies and institutional capacities strengthened in the areas of education, health, social assistance, food security and nutrition and decent work in order to address the needs of the most vulnerable groups and promote gender, race, ethnicity throughout the life course
planEntities.description:
The Joint Program SDG Fund was created within the framework of the UN's international reform process and relies on resources from several countries. It aims to encourage countries to accelerate the achievement of the 17 SDGs in an integrated manner, with the support of the UN System.
In Brazil, the Joint SDG Fund – support for the Happy Child Program, is based on evidence that investment gaps in Early Childhood and their families/caregivers are an obstacle to achieving sustainable development.

By supporting the Criança Feliz PCF Program, focusing on Early Childhood development, the Joint SDG Fund seeks to accelerate the SDGs in the country.

planEntities.name: UNFPA UN Interagency Advisory Group for Youth
planEntities.parentName: 1.1 Public policies and institutional capacities strengthened in the areas of education, health, social assistance, food security and nutrition and decent work in order to address the needs of the most vulnerable groups and promote gender, race, ethnicity throughout the life course
planEntities.description: Coordinated by UNFPA Brazil CO and with participation of 20 UNCT members was an important support to provide evidence-based advocacy and technical assistance in working with adolescents and youth within the actions coordinated by the different UNCT members. The Group aims at establishing a space for dialogue between governments, civil society and UN agencies on the topic of Youth, providing technical assistance to the UNCT and strengthening articulation and joint work in initiatives focusing on Brazilian youth. The Group did not carry out activities originally planned to 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic and funds expired in December. Activities restarted in May 2021, after the renewal of funds and updating of focal points. The first action was about Durban+20, named "Cinema do Futuro". In 2022, the group hired a UNV to map youth organizations that work to combat climate change.
